newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices bounce back on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices bounce back on mill buying.

text.p: Indian cotton prices bounced back on Friday on increased mill buying and restricted offerings by state firms, dealers said.
They said millers remained active buyers ahead of festivals on firm sentiment.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi (ready delivery) rose by 20/35 rupees to 875/900 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while November delivery moved up by 15/20 rupees to 950 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) gained by 400/600 rupees to 12,900/13,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
